<!--
GitHub offers no setting that disables pull requests (Issues, Projects, and the
Wiki are all off; PRs cannot be turned off the same way). This template is
therefore the only notice a would-be contributor gets before opening one.
-->

**This repository is a publish-only mirror. Pull requests here cannot be merged.**

The contents are generated from an internal Databrill monorepo and synced
one-way; a change committed here would be overwritten by the next sync, and
there is no path to carry it upstream through this repository.

If you have found a bug or need a change, contact Databrill directly rather
than opening a pull request.
